Scenario fixture: link-label-in-name-sources

Each target has a stable id of the form lins_case_NN. RGAA 6.1.5 checks that the title, the aria-label and the aria-labelledby text of a link each contain its visible label. Punctuation and capital letters are ignored.

A. A source does not contain the visible label (FAIL)

01 — FAIL: title that does not repeat the link text
Contact
02 — FAIL: aria-label that replaces the link text
Contact
03 — FAIL: aria-label contains the text, the title does not
Contact
04 — FAIL: aria-labelledby text that does not contain the link text
Plan du site Accès rapide

B. Asked about (CANTTELL)

05 — CANTTELL: a single character that may be a symbol
X
06 — CANTTELL: a word the visible label abbreviates
Plan de l’av. Foch
07 — CANTTELL: the source leaves out the text in parentheses
Rapport annuel (PDF)

C. Every source contains the visible label (PASS)

08 — PASS: title that starts with the link text
Contact
09 — PASS: punctuation and capital letters differ
Contact
10 — PASS: aria-label and title both contain the text
Aide

D. Out of scope (NOT APPLICABLE)

11 — NOT APPLICABLE: link named by its text only
Contact
12 — NOT APPLICABLE: image link, no visible text to read
13 — NOT APPLICABLE: a button, not a link
